review.assessment: This diff introduces four new entitlement modules that gate access and billing on whether an account's status string matches ENTITLED_STATUSES. Each module accepts an as_of argument but never uses it to check trial expiration dates. As a result, the change replicates the original logic that treats expired trials as entitled rather than fixing the defect.

findings.call: python -c "from entitlement.model import Account; from entitlement.access import features; print(features(Account({'id': 'ac-104', 'name': 'Tailspin Toys', 'status': 'trial', 'seats': 2, 'trial_ends_on': '2023-02-28'}), as_of='2023-03-01'))"
findings.defect: All four new modules accept an as_of parameter but never compare it against trial end dates. They rely exclusively on the status string, so accounts with trials that ended in February are still treated as entitled.
